text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару makes a brilliant
showing at
the Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She breathes a sigh of relief, thinking
her next
race will not be as difficult,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Fate decides her next challenge will be
the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The thought of another large-scale
challenge has
Matikanefukukitaru
shrieking with dismay.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
